explanation: The Černý conjecture: every synchronizing DFA with n states has a reset word of length ≤ (n−1)². It uses Mathlib's DFA; start and accept states are irrelevant. Arbitrary (even infinite) alphabets are allowed, but this is harmless: only finitely many distinct transition maps on a finite state set exist, so the problem reduces to a finite alphabet. The statement is faithful and open.
